description: Free first look for an invention described in plain text: searches official patent office records and returns how many verified related patents turned up, their main classes, the 3 closest with links, and how to order the full search report. No analysis or opinion. Limited to 5 previews per hour per user. Free, no key. Returns drafts only, not legal advice. Results must be reviewed by a registered patent attorney or patent agent.

description.description: Plain-text description of the invention: what it is and how it works, 1-5 sentences. Example: "A phone case with a fold-out stand that also acts as a cooling fan intake."

key_features.description: Optional main features, one short phrase each (max 8). Example: ["fold-out stand","fan intake vent"]

keywords.description: Optional search words or synonyms (max 8). Example: ["phone case","kickstand","cooling"]

name: preview_patentability
title: Free patentability preview
